reason_for_new_version: The historical v2 and v3 runs measure Python models and v5 repeats one fixed artifact. Version 7 executes a growing family through the same compiled Lean incremental and complete checkers.
scientific_scope: Paired observed costs and structural certificate accounting for a generated family of compiled neural artifacts. This is not a complexity theorem and is not evidence about all neural systems.
source_freeze_mode: content-addressed complete Lean source tree because commit creation was not authorized before the run

parameters.determinism: The generator, schedule and checkers are deterministic; no random source is used.

paired_execution.same_source: At every step both checker paths consume the same current CheckedAgent.
paired_execution.same_target: At every step both checker paths consume the same ScalingReceivedArtifact.
paired_execution.successor_equality: ScalingPairedStepResult.successorExact identifies their checked successors in Lean.
paired_execution.continuation: Only the accepted incremental successor becomes the source of the next step.

practical_gain_rule.name: substantial-cumulative-incremental-gain
practical_gain_rule.decision: Gain is true only if the median initial-plus-incremental trace cost is at most 80 percent of the median initial-plus-full-recheck trace cost at every assessed size.

resource_budget.failure_policy: A timeout, memory limit or rejected step is reported as absence of a result within budget and never as falsity of a mathematical property.

negative_control.required_outcome: nonzero process exit before any accepted observation

interpretation_rules: Elapsed time and memory are observations, not Lean theorems.
Structural reuse is reported separately from practical speed.
A slower incremental path is published without reclassification.
The family must grow in neural nodes, structural profile width and causal graph nodes.
No asymptotic law is inferred from eight finite sizes.
The confirmatory result file is created once and never overwritten.
